build_EuclideanCodebook: build a EuclideanCodebook with a given dimension and codebook size for nearest centroid lookup
encode_VectorQuantization: encode a tensor of shape [B, D, N] into discrete integer codes using VectorQuantization
decode_VectorQuantization: decode integer codes back into quantized vectors using the VectorQuantization decode method
encode_ResidualVectorQuantization: encode an input tensor into stacked integer codes across multiple RVQ quantizer layers
decode_ResidualVectorQuantization: decode stacked integer codes from RVQ back into reconstructed quantized vectors
